name: Can I live in my home during the earthquake retrofit process?

mainEntity.name: Can I live in my home during the earthquake retrofit process?

acceptedAnswer.text: In most cases, homeowners can remain in their homes during an earthquake retrofit. The work is primarily focused on the crawl space or foundation. However, projects involving extensive interior work, significant foundation replacement, or utility disconnections might require temporary relocation for safety and convenience. Your coordinator will advise you on the specific requirements and potential disruptions based on your project's scope.
acceptedAnswer.description: Typically, you can stay home during a retrofit. Relocation may be needed for extensive interior or foundation work, or utility disconnections.
